## 2. About

```
I design public buildings for the Government of Punjab, and research how Lahore's parks, markets and mosques can work for everyone who uses them — women included.

I am an architect in Lahore. Since 2022 I have worked as Assistant Director Architecture in the Punjab Architecture Department of the Communication & Works Department, designing and managing public building projects for the Government of Punjab. I graduated from Lahore College for Women University as the gold medallist of the Bachelor of Architecture.

Before government service I spent three years as an architect at Kazmain Design & Interior Contractors, leading design projects for private clients and seeing them through construction, while teaching architectural design as a visiting lecturer in the department where I had studied.

My master's research at the University of Engineering and Technology, Lahore, asks what the COVID-19 pandemic changed about how people use the city's parks, markets and mosques — and found that in the neighbourhoods I studied, those spaces were never equally open to women. Designing and planning public space that works for everyone who depends on it is the work I want to do next.

Software: AutoCAD, Revit, SketchUp, Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, Prezi, Microsoft Office.

Open to architecture and urban-design roles, and to funded postgraduate study in urban design and the planning of inclusive public space.

Portfolio: (portfolio URL — set once the GitHub username is known)
```

### Assistant Director Architecture (CAD) — Punjab Architecture Department, Communication & Works Department, Government of Punjab

**Dates:** Mar 2022 – Present

Public-sector architect in the provincial department responsible for government buildings: designing and managing public projects and overseeing their construction.

- Design and manage public building projects for the Government of Punjab, ensuring compliance with building regulations and government standards.
- Coordinate with stakeholders and oversee construction on site, keeping public projects to standard through to completion.
- Uphold standards for sustainable, functional architecture in community and government infrastructure projects.

## 8. Settings that matter

- **Open to work** — recruiters only. Job titles: Architect, Project Architect, Design Architect, Postgraduate scholarships in architecture and urban design, PhD and research master's programmes, Research assistantships.
- **Featured** — pin the portfolio site and the portfolio PDF. For an architect, this section is
  the shop window: it is the first place a recruiter sees work rather than words.
- **Custom URL** — claim a clean `linkedin.com/in/…`; the default with digits looks unfinished on a CV.
- **Location** — Lahore, Pakistan.
- **Contact info** — ar.amnabashir@gmail.com and the portfolio URL.
- **Banner** — one of her own renders or drawings, never the default.
